WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
bench1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS b1 FROM per_order
),
above1 AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.b1 AS margin1
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN bench1 b
  WHERE p.avg_fill > b.b1
),
bench2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS b2 FROM above1
),
final AS (
  SELECT a.ordersmark, a.avg_fill, a.margin1, a.avg_fill - b.b2 AS margin2
  FROM above1 a
  CROSS JOIN bench2 b
  WHERE a.avg_fill > b.b2
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill_final,
  AVG(margin1) AS avg_margin_over_overall,
  AVG(margin2) AS avg_margin_over_group
FROM final;
